```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
births_by_calendar_day <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
ggplot(births_by_calendar_day, aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = mean_births)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of month",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Mean births"
  )
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    baseline_births = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * christmas_births / baseline_births,
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * resid(births_model) / mean(births))

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  select(calendar_date, mean_pct_resid)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(format(calendar_date, "%m-%d") %in% c("01-01", "07-04", "12-25")) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = recode(
      format(calendar_date, "%m-%d"),
      "01-01" = "New Year's Day",
      "07-04" = "Independence Day",
      "12-25" = "Christmas"
    ),
    label_date = calendar_date + case_when(
      holiday == "New Year's Day" ~ 3,
      holiday == "Independence Day" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 4
    ),
    label_y = case_when(
      holiday == "New Year's Day" ~ -21,
      holiday == "Independence Day" ~ -18,
      TRUE ~ -37
    ),
    label_hjust = if_else(holiday == "Christmas", 1, 0)
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(
      x = label_date,
      y = label_y,
      label = holiday,
      hjust = label_hjust
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of average births)"
  )
```
